replacement.instructions: Choose the alternative most compatible with the required ownership and replacement semantics.

criteria.staged: Accept exact windows and unit data under a verified customer namespace. Charge whole aligned hour units or individual day windows, calculate uncovered usage as money, and preserve the earlier booking during staging until commit swaps its allocations. This requires additional stage/fence persistence and precise credit treatment for overlapping periods.
criteria.independent: Allocate the entire new usage without crediting old usage, then discard the earlier allocation once all new resources agree. This avoids exchange-accounting complications and keeps old rights intact, but double temporary demand can prevent admissible modifications.
criteria.release_first: Discard the existing reservation first and then allocate its successor. This needs fewer staged records and conserves temporary balance, at the cost of potentially losing a still-valid original reservation when the successor fails or another consumer spends released units.
